scope: Accepted H six Direct author triples plus six normal-WL author triples; no providers, token costs, quality exclusion, parked R, or runtime changes.

method.direct_initial_window: All18 initial new-test sequences from the pinned reviewed timing census; every leading-cargo call issued from first test patch through the last first exact-command GREEN for that census's RED commands, retaining later outputs of calls already issued by that cutoff. No non-leading exec command mentioning cargo occurs inside these windows. Source inspections, invalid invocations, fixture edits and later checks are not relabeled initial behavioral RED.
method.command_identity: Join native input/output by exact same-thread call_id, not adjacency or response-count inference. Commands and their original outputs retain SHA256 and physical line/item/turn identities.
method.test_identity: Same command and matching printed test names do not prove unchanged test bytes. Every intervening accepted patch is retained; test/source state remains unproven unless independently replayed. H native logs lack the newer exact token-usage response IDs.
method.success_repeat_inventory: Across every18 complete Direct author sessions, retain successive successful occurrences of each identical leading-cargo-test string only when no intervening accepted apply_patch occurs. Intervening formatter/native actions are retained, not treated as absent. No candidate proves byte-identical whole source state.
method.wl_inventory: All58 actual command-result inputs and exact preceding public locked-command+typed reply; every check has an earlier accepted same-author implementation group. Concurrent other-author ACKs are retained separately, not assumed irrelevant or merged with own state.
method.source_limits: Read public tool/message fields only. Test summary counts are actual reported testing outcomes, not usage counters or model responses. No aggregate token totals or inferred causal share.
method.transport_notes: Early exploratory full-ledger/large-row stdout exceeded display limits and was not used as a retained census; final projections were processed one run at a time. A timing-table server hash supplied the source pin absent from the native-actions client-only inventory; historical inputs were not edited.
